Convert the field of view from degrees to radians and compute half-FOV sine and cosine [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the evidence supports the process of converting the field of view from degrees to radians and computing half-FOV sine and cosine. Source [S1] notes explicitly contain the line: 'Calculate half-FOV sine and cosine: DirectX::XMScalarSinCos(&sin_fov, &cos_fov, 0.5f * DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(45.0f));'. This line demonstrates exactly the operations described in the claim (converting 45.0f degrees to radians, taking half of that value, and computing sine and cosine). Therefore, every fact in the claim is present in the evidence.
